name: Microsoft Copilot
description: Microsoft describes Copilot as an AI assistant that helps you create, research, analyse and get things done in the Microsoft 365 apps you use. Individual access comes through Microsoft 365 plans.
features: Copilot in Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook (desktop)
Advanced Copilot chat with higher usage than free
Visual AI, audio and image creation on higher plans
audience: Families (Family plan, owner only for AI features)
strengths: Bundled with Microsoft 365 storage and apps
One-month free trial on Personal, Family and Premium
limitations: AI features cannot be shared on the Family plan
Usage limits apply and app availability varies by device and language

plans.name: Microsoft 365 Personal
highlights: Copilot in desktop Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook

plans.name: Microsoft 365 Family
limits: AI features are for the subscription owner only

plans.name: Microsoft 365 Premium
highlights: Extensive chat, visual AI, audio and image creation usage

free.details: The page refers to 'higher usage than free' but does not describe the free plan's limits.

pricing.trial: One-month free trial on Microsoft 365 Personal, Family and Premium.

profile.headline: AI help inside Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook, for individuals

capabilities.title: Get a first draft in Word
capabilities.text: Prompt with the task, add or upload notes, and refine in chat.

capabilities.title: Find insights in Excel data
capabilities.text: Describe the task, attach data and adjust the result through chat.

capabilities.title: Go from prompt to presentation
capabilities.text: In PowerPoint, outline the flow, describe visuals and generate slides.

capabilities.title: Keep on top of your inbox
capabilities.text: Outlook summaries help you stay organised and see next steps.

featureCards.name: Cowork
featureCards.text: An AI collaborator in the Microsoft Copilot app that plans and completes multi-step tasks while you stay in control.

featureCards.name: AI Restyle in OneDrive
featureCards.text: AI-powered editing to give photos new looks and styles.

featureCards.name: The Microsoft Copilot app
featureCards.text: One place to chat, create and edit content, manage projects and find files on the go.

featureCards.name: Conditions the page states
featureCards.text: Copilot in Excel needs AutoSave, so the file must be saved to OneDrive; AI features are for the subscription owner and cannot be shared; availability varies by device and language.

audienceDetail.text: Copilot in the apps needs a Personal, Family or Premium subscription.
The page mentions special offers for eligible students.
A Workplace Discount Program is mentioned.

scenarios.title: Draft a document from notes
scenarios.text: Upload your notes and have Copilot produce a first Word draft.

scenarios.title: Analyse a spreadsheet
scenarios.text: Attach data and ask for the insight in plain language.

scenarios.title: Build a deck
scenarios.text: Let Copilot reference a file to create a PowerPoint presentation.

scenarios.title: Catch up on email
scenarios.text: Read a summary of the inbox and what to do next.

gettingStarted.text: The page describes a one-month free trial of Microsoft 365 Premium.
The Copilot learning center has short videos for Word, Excel, Outlook and other apps.
Optionally download the Microsoft Copilot app.
Use your Microsoft account to manage the subscription.
